name: rewrite-clusters
body: The four rewrite clusters across the agent files: (A) JSONL-fallback → stop-and-report; (B) "ask the user one at a time" → route questions through the coordinator (including agent-builder's interview workflow, which now interviews via the coordinator); (C) "if the graph is stale, fall back to read/glob/grep" → report the stale graph to the coordinator (the navigator runs the scan — a coordinator action, not a file read); (D) strip all `.trans`/`layers` path references and drop the "read `.opencode/agents/codebase-navigator.md` for the schema" hint (wrong for downstream + a path leak).
